rationale: Luke's founding experience building Reasonote, an AI-powered adaptive learning platform, and his conviction that personalized learning will transform education directly align with Dylan's mission at Casey AI to scale career guidance through AI. Both are shipping in the edtech/AI space with overlapping tech stacks (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript) and share a belief that AI can solve endemic scaling problems in education and career systems—Luke's focus on granular knowledge graphs for mastery-level personalization complements Dylan's work on systematizing one-to-many coaching at scale.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Dylan Bryan — you're both building AI solutions to scale education and career systems, and your backgrounds in founding/shipping (Luke at Reasonote, Dylan at Casey AI) and hands-on domain expertise would make for a valuable conversation on personalized learning at scale.
